archetypes.name: dyn-hook-bridge
archetypes.rationale: Stop and PreToolUse hook sidecars now coordinate across notification turns.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new no-progress-task-output-clamped bridge between hook-bg-poll-guard.sh and hook-no-progress-guard.sh. Check that unchanged task-output Read denials arm the Stop path, that changed output clears the bridge, and that generic no-progress behavior remains one-shot. Pay attention to symlink and stale-sidecar cleanup semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
